faq.question: What do I need to provide to get started with your website design service?
faq.answer: Please provide detailed requirements, any relevant files or information, and your specific goals. The more information you share, the better I can meet your expectations.

faq.question: How long does delivery typically take?
faq.answer: Delivery times vary by package: Basic (3 days), Standard (2 days), Premium (1 day). Rush delivery may be available for urgent projects.

faq.question: Do you offer revisions?
faq.answer: Yes! I offer 1 revision for Basic, 3 revisions for Standard, and unlimited revisions for Premium packages. Your satisfaction is guaranteed.

faq.question: What if I'm not satisfied with the work?
faq.answer: Your satisfaction is my top priority. I offer revisions on all packages and will work with you until you're happy with the results.

faq.question: Can I contact you before placing an order?
faq.answer: Absolutely! I highly recommend messaging me first to discuss your project and ensure I'm the right fit for your needs.

faq.question: Do you offer custom packages?
faq.answer: Yes, I can create custom packages for unique requirements. Please message me to discuss your specific needs.

faq.question: What's your availability for communication?
faq.answer: I'm generally available 24/7 for messages and updates. I typically respond within 2-4 hours during business days.
